metadata.title: OCR PDF Translator for Scanned Documents
metadata.description: Use OCR to recognize text in scanned PDFs, review the detected layout, translate supported languages, and export the result. Sign-in is required.

intro: Upload a scanned or image-based PDF, recognize its text, review the detected blocks, and translate the content into one of the supported languages before export.
useCases: Scanned research papers, supplier documents, manuals, and other PDFs whose text cannot be selected or copied.
limits: Sign-in is required. Blurry scans, handwriting, complex tables, unusual fonts, and password-protected PDFs may need manual review or preprocessing.
